title: Who Is Telling the Story?
description: Use words in short, picture-supported stories to identify whether a character or someone outside the story is telling what happened.
learningFocus: Use words in a story to determine who is telling what happened (RL.1.6), while reading grade-appropriate stories with support (RL.1.10).
adultGuidance: Every story has someone who tells it. Help your child listen for words like I, my, we, and our. Those words can help show that a character in the story tells it. He and she can be in any story. Ask: Who is telling us what happened? Then look at the words for clues.
